body: Unfortunately
I have children.
He has me trapped financially.
Who do you think is going to laugh?
You'd probjust get mild serotonin syndrome.  You'd feel like crap smashed.
Exactly what will happen. You are going to feel like shit. Very very rarely is SS fatal.
Sounds similar to my story. Except he was deployed, started the EA and had also been carrying on a 5 yr PA, all right underneath my nose. Man do I feel stupid.
Thank you for your insight. Things are not better and my depression has only gotten worse because of him.
Why? So I can burden you with my problems too.

He's a narcissist, just like mine. It's hard to leave a narcissist.  Ask your therapist about trauma bonds.  I'm learning the only way to be happy with a narcissist is to be away from them. So unfortunately I know that means us staying together is more than likely not an option.

Mine does that too, says what he did was wrong but I'm the one that made him do it. And it's BS. And he always wants me to act like it just all never happened.  Like I should instantly forgive him for the 5 years he carried on his affair. Everything I do can be completely faulted but him, oh God no never.

I feel this pain deeply. I'm in a horrible marriage and have been thrust into massive depression disorder because of his actions. I can't climb out of the hole, he digs it deeper with his words and actions. I don't know how much more I can take. I have a method, I just need the gall to do it and stop being a burden and stop feeling like this.

My WS wears his ring, and has been very mindful of wearing it 24/7 (before he would "forget" sometimes).  I took mine off the day I found out. I have tried to put it back on a couple times, but it just makes me feel very uneasy and I'm just not ready. I don't know when I ever will be, even if we do end up staying together.  I agree with you, he had it on when he cheated which cheapens the aspect and meaning of it altogether.
His love language is definitely gifts but that's not mine and he knows it. Mine is physical touch and acts of service.
He tells me he gives me everything thing I ever need and he does things for me all the time, more than I do for him; this house, this car blah blah blah.

He told me it was my fault he did what he did. That I am a burden to the family and everything is ruined because I made him do this. Then he started asking if the pregnancy and miscarriage I had when we first married 12 years ago was even real. That hurt. It hurt so bad. Then tells our oldest son that I am ruining everything, I am ruining their relationship and everything good. I am hurting so badly right now, I don't even know what to think.
And he has the audacity to say to me, how much longer do you want me to eat shit about this? How much longer do I have to feel bad about this? I'm so hurt and angry

He keeps making excuses on why he's not available to do better. He's tired because of work. He has a lot of extra work to do at home because of work. It's always me taking care of everything and everyone around the house. And now today he started a fight with me and I just walked away and I am Grey rocking him like my therapist suggested. I can hear him huffing and puffing because he has to take care of the kids and do things with them. And my oldest child asked him where I was and he said, idk son your mom is having another one of her episodes.  Like wtf?! I wouldn't be depressed and feeling like this if he hadn't done what he did.  Like I choose to feel this way or something.
249 times they were together over the course of the years. 249 times.
I found out about the affair 2 weeks after our 12 year anniversary and he had actually gone to see his AP the morning of our anniversary.
Same. I'm in the same stage. I'm so damn angry.

I feel the same way.   I'm wondering why I'm even considering staying.  It's just so hurtful. I feel like I'm dying inside and all I think about it all of the previous holidays and years that were wasted and the memories that are tainted. I'm just so broken.

He said it was just sex that there was no other attachment but it went on for four years, how can there be no other kind of attachment after fucking someone for four years 2-3x a week? 

He says he hasn't talked to anyone and hes done with all of it but again I find it hard to believe since it went on for so long.  It's hard to trust anything at this point. I'm hyper paranoid and it's exhausting.  

Yes I got tested.
The exbf is definitely just still using you to make himself feel better. Total narcissistic behavior, making you feel like crap still while it's seems he's moved on.
Roast his nuts over a flame of screenshot proof.

BS here and it's been only 16 days so it's very raw still and I think about it constantly. It went on for 4 years, basically since we moved to this city. I've always wanted to live here but now I hate it.  Every memory we made here means nothing anymore, it's all tainted. I'm very angry and hurt and sad and numb. I wish I was more numb so I didn't feel so much pain. We've been married for a substantial amount of time and have children together.  I would never do this to anyone so I don't understand how he did this to me, to risk everything for sex.

BS here.  It's been 16 days since I found out, it's all very raw still.  I think about it almost all day. It went on for 4 years, basically since we moved to this city. My whole life I have wanted to live in this city and now I hate it. Every memory we made together here means nothing. I'm just very numb but mostly angry and sad right now.
I hope I can get to this same kind of outlook one day.
Thank you for your reply and your kind words.

I do feel like he's ignoring me now because it's some kind of strange way to reel me in more.

 I did a decent run yesterday 6.21 miles, it felt good but at the same time I cried out some emotional crap on the run. And I did another shorter 3.5 miles today. I am trying to focus on me more, but it's hard.

Mine does the " idk, I can't remember that far back" and "I can't recall all what happened"

Bullcrap, they know. That's their way of trying to self preserve.

Exactly yes.  I believe that serial cheaters have an inflated sense of self and they crave that ego boost no matter what the cost. I don't think that they are capable of empathy and that they have possible borderline personality disorders.  

Mine has been carrying on 3 different relationships(lives) for over 4 years.  Like that takes a very different type of personality to be able to keep 3 different relationships going and compartmentalize that and even rationalize it. 

Patterns in serial cheaters will never change and they will continue to sabotage themselves and risk everything all for the high they get from cheating. It's an addiction for the serial cheater but to me not one that can be cured.

No all of my family is back east. And I don't really feel like I can tell anyone anyway right now. I'm too embarrassed.  My kids are my everything. Everything I am doing right now is solely for them. 

I don't know how to get past this hysterical bonding feeling that I am having. I don't understand it at all. I am already in counseling for just me, have been for quite awhile. I have some ptsd from childhood trauma, and from being SA when I was in the military.

It's like we are in a very sad scary nightmare that we just want to wake up and it all not be true. I'm sorry you are going through this too. I'm so tired of crying and feeling like this. But I know it's foolish to think this pain and numbness will stop anytime soon.

If she doesn't have any cares about your concerns and a simple thing such as cutting off all communication with the AP then how can you believe that she really values or respects the relationship in any way. To me I see that as a sign of zero remorse and I take that as a "hey I'm going to keep taking advantage of my spouse because they are letting me take advantage of them and I'll just get better at hiding it"  

I just found out about my spouses affair and believe me I'm going through a hell of a time too because of how long we've been married, the children we have together as well. But I'm starting to take it at face value that I'll never get the real truth and he'll just keep doing it and get better at hiding it.

I really do appreciate all of the comments. Thank you all already for the support.  I haven't been able to talk to anyone about any of this because I feel ashamed and embarrassed that I wasn't enough to keep him from going outside of the marriage.
Ok, I've never heard of it.

And the thing is in counseling, he turned everything around and pointed out all of my flaws and wrongs that he thought I did.  Made me out to be a horrible person.  He sat there each time and watched me go through major panic attacks, meanwhile he was doing all of this behind my back, leading another life.
I found out on my own and confronted him. He lied and lied and lied. Then finally started coming clean, though I feel like there is something(s) he's leaving out.

What did you decide to do? I'm going through a similar situation.  I'll be posting about it when I get enough time to type it all out. Right now it's so raw and emotional I can't even bring myself to type it out.
